levels.label: Good
levels.description: Air quality is satisfactory, and air pollution poses little or no risk.

levels.label: Moderate
levels.description: Air quality is acceptable. However, there may be a risk for some people, particularly those who are unusually sensitive to air pollution.
levels.guidance: Highly sensitive groups should stay indoors and avoid outdoor activities.

levels.label: Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups
levels.description: Members of sensitive groups may experience health effects. The general public is less likely to be affected.
levels.guidance: Sensitive groups should stay indoors and avoid outdoor activities.

levels.label: Unhealthy
levels.description: Some members of the general public may experience health effects; members of sensitive groups may experience more serious health effects.
levels.guidance: Everyone should reduce prolonged or heavy exertion.

levels.label: Very Unhealthy
levels.description: Health alert: The risk of health effects is increased for everyone.
levels.guidance: Everyone should avoid prolonged or heavy exertion.

levels.label: Hazardous
levels.description: Health warning of emergency conditions: everyone is more likely to be affected.
levels.guidance: Everyone should stay indoors and avoid physical outdoor activities.

raw.label: Raw
raw.description: The reading exactly as the monitor or its data provider reported it, before any adjustment.

corrected.label: Corrected
corrected.description: Raw readings from a monitor's two sensors checked against each other and combined into one value.

cleaned.label: Cleaned
cleaned.description: Readings with obvious errors removed or smoothed, such as impossible values and short spikes.

calibrated.label: Calibrated
calibrated.description: Readings adjusted to better match reference-grade instruments, or aggregated or computed by the data provider.

AQLiteRawCleaner.label: Ozone range and warm-up check
AQLiteRawCleaner.description: Discards impossible ozone readings and readings taken in the 20 minutes after the sensor restarts, while it warms up.

AirGradientHumidity.label: Humidity correction
AirGradientHumidity.description: Corrects AirGradient and PurpleAir relative humidity readings using AirGradient's published equation, capped at 100 percent.

AirGradientTemperature.label: Temperature correction
AirGradientTemperature.description: Corrects AirGradient and PurpleAir outdoor temperature readings using AirGradient's published equation; indoor monitors are skipped.

O3_VOZBox.label: VOZBox ozone calibration
O3_VOZBox.description: Adjusts raw VOZBox ozone using a fit that accounts for temperature and humidity.

PM25_EPA_Oct2021.label: EPA correction (Oct 2021)
PM25_EPA_Oct2021.description: Adjusts low-cost sensor PM2.5 using humidity, following the EPA's October 2021 PurpleAir correction for the Fire and Smoke Map.

PM25_FEM_Cleaner.label: Range check for reference monitors
PM25_FEM_Cleaner.description: Discards impossible PM2.5 readings from reference-grade monitors and sets small negative values to zero.

PM25_LCS_Cleaning.label: Spike cleaning
PM25_LCS_Cleaning.description: Replaces a sudden one-reading jump in PM2.5 with the higher of the neighboring readings when it far exceeds them.

PM25_LCS_Correction.label: Two-sensor check and blend
PM25_LCS_Correction.description: Compares a monitor's two PM2.5 sensors, drops bad or stuck readings, and averages them when they agree (or uses the lower one when they don't).

PM25_MultivariateLinearRegression.label: Linear calibration (with weather)
PM25_MultivariateLinearRegression.description: Adjusts low-cost sensor PM2.5 using a fit to a reference monitor that also accounts for temperature and humidity.

PM25_UnivariateLinearRegression.label: Linear calibration (PM2.5 only)
PM25_UnivariateLinearRegression.description: Adjusts low-cost sensor PM2.5 with a straight-line fit built by comparing nearby sensors to a reference monitor.
